Control options for clipped scree estimation

Source: R/scree.R
clipped_control.Rd

Creates a control list for method = "clipped" in dp_scree() or the scree configuration of dp_pca().

Usage

clipped_control(C_clip)

Arguments

C_clip

Required positive public clipping threshold for squared pair differences. Larger values reduce clipping bias but increase Gaussian noise; data-dependent selection requires separate privacy accounting.

Value

A control list for method = "clipped".

Details

The method clips the paired quantities at C_clip and adds Gaussian noise to their vector of column means. For \(m=\lfloor n/2\rfloor\) pairs and \(k\) components, the calibration uses vector sensitivity \(\sqrt{k}\,C_{clip}/m\) under the conditions in dp_scree(). Larger thresholds reduce clipping bias but increase the noise scale.

References

Dwork C, Roth A (2014). “The Algorithmic Foundations of Differential Privacy.” Found. Trends Theor. Comput. Sci., 9(3–4), 211–407. ISSN 1551-305X, doi:10.1561/0400000042 .

See also

dp_scree() for using clipped scree estimation. plot.dp_scree() for plotting private scree estimates.

Examples

clipped_control(C_clip = 3)
#> $C_clip
#> [1] 3
#>
